cohort: 468 randomly selected pregnant women in Arusha City, Tanzania (392 returned for postpartum assessments), excluding those with pre-existing diabetes.
finding: Postpartum hyperglycemia was significantly associated with increased body fat percentage, mid-upper arm circumference, macrosomia, and family history of type 2 diabetes.
mod_finding: The majority of women had normal delivery (92.6%), while 7.4% delivered through caesarean section.
birth_weight: Macrosomia (8.2% of newborns) and low birth weight (4.1% of newborns)
